messages:
ana: Heads-up — ACME (acct: acme-inc) reserved GPU request req-9876 has been stuck in `pending-billing` for ~28h. Billing shows a charge but no capacity assigned, customer is pinging CSM. Anyone able to triage? :thinking_face:

sre-bot: automated alert: reservation-service queue depth=67, oldest_pending=27h, region=us-west2, controller=reservation-controller-4. Recent errors: "billing: invoice lookup mismatch" x12.

kevin: looking. I can see req-9876 at position 42 in the fulfillment queue. Reservation service logs show repeated 409 from billing API: 
```
2026-02-14T09:12:03Z ERROR billing: invoice id mismatch for req-9876, expected inv-54321 got inv-null
2026-02-14T09:12:05Z WARN retrying billing lookup (attempt 3)
```

jon: is this the new billing adapter changes rolled last week? we had a migration that changed invoice id shape. Could be a schema mismatch. :eyes:

finance: we see a charge logged under on-demand rather than reserved for that acct at 2026-02-13T22:00Z. Looks like reservation order didn't mark invoice as reserved_commit. We'll likely need to apply a credit if we can't re-run the reservation. Opening a billing investigation now.

kevin: short-term options: 1) force-fulfill the reservation bypassing billing check (not ideal), 2) move customer to a temporary spot-burst pool for the committed capacity window and reconcile billing later, or 3) cancel and re-create the reservation after billing fix. Thoughts?

ana: (cc @oncall) customer SLA is 99.9% for Dedicated; they have a pilot starting tomorrow — we need capacity or a plan to avoid outage.

oncall: I'll run a force-fulfill as a temporary emergency measure if infra signs off. Post-run we'll need an audit entry and finance approval for credit/reconciliation. ETA ~3m to execute.

kevin: action plan: I'll try a controlled force-fulfill on req-9876 with audit flags and a dry-run first. Command: 
```
kubectl exec -it deploy/reservation-controller -- /bin/resv-admin fulfill --id req-9876 --force --audit "temp-fulfill-billing-mismatch"
```

kevin: dry-run shows allocation possible from reserved pool but billing check fails. Proceeding with force after ack.

jon: we should also patch the billing adapter to accept the old invoice id shape or fallback gracefully. I'll raise INFRA-5432 to track the adapter fix and add an alert when billing returns 4xx for reservation flows.

finance: please capture the charge txn id and we will flag it for credit if we do force-fulfill. Finance will also block double-billing.

oncall: executing force-fulfill now.

sre-bot: action log: req-9876 force-fulfill executed by oncall at 2026-02-14T09:20:12Z, status=allocated -> node gpu-pool-reserved-03, audit="temp-fulfill-billing-mismatch". queue_depth now 66.

ana: customer updated: CSM informed, they can proceed with pilot if we provision. Thanks. :thumbsup:

finance: noted. We'll reconcile and post credits within 3 business days if necessary. Keeping ticket open.

kevin: follow-ups: 1) INFRA-5432 for billing adapter fix, 2) add an SLO alert for billing 4xx on reservations, 3) run a backfill job to reconcile any reqs stuck in pending-billing last 7 days. I'll file PRs today.

ana: thanks all. please ping here when INFRA-5432 exists so ops and finance can watch.

oncall: closing emergency for now, leaving thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
